states.offlineBody: Check your connection, then try again.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.INVALID_CODE: That code isn't valid or has expired.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.CONFLICT: That conflicts with a more recent change. Refresh and try again.
errors.STALE_CURSOR: The list changed while you were reading it. Refresh to continue.
errors.STALE_STATE: This changed on another device. Refresh to see the latest.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: That request was already used for a different action. Try again.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You've reached your plan's limit for {{limit}}: {{used}} of {{max}}.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED_GENERIC: You've reached a limit of your plan.
errors.INVITE_REQUIRED: Bantoozi is invite-only for now. You need an invite code to sign up.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The analysis service isn't available right now. Try again later.
errors.STAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This part of Bantoozi isn't available yet.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.FEED_BLOCKED_ADDRESS: That address can't be used for a feed.
errors.FEED_TIMEOUT: The website took too long to answer.
errors.FEED_TLS_ERROR: We couldn't open a secure connection to that website.
errors.FEED_CONNECTION_ERROR: We couldn't connect to that website.
errors.FEED_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: That address redirects too many times.
errors.FEED_INVALID_URL: That isn't a valid feed address.
errors.FEED_DECODE_ERROR: We couldn't read the text encoding of that feed.
errors.FEED_ORIGIN_COOLDOWN: That website asked us to slow down. Try again later.
errors.FEED_HTTP: The website answered with an error ({{status}}).
errors.NETWORK: You seem to be offline, or the server can't be reached.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The server sent an answer we couldn't understand. Try again.
